stops.name: Lake Moron
stops.quote: A chance to admire the beautiful Lake Moron, the Saut-du-Doubs waterfall and Lake Brenets.
stops.english: A chance to admire the beautiful Lake Moron, the Saut-du-Doubs waterfall and Lake Brenets.

stops.name: Lac des Brenets
stops.quote: The water of the river Doubs, which has been dammed up by landslide debris, forms the four kilometer long, but only 200 meter wide, winding Lac des Brenets.
stops.english: The water of the river Doubs, which has been dammed up by landslide debris, forms the four kilometer long, but only 200 meter wide, winding Lac des Brenets.

stops.name: Saut du Doubs
stops.quote: The trail leads to the Saut du Doubs, a spectacular, 27m high waterfall.
stops.english: The trail leads to the Saut du Doubs, a spectacular, 27m high waterfall.

stops.name: Le Theusseret
stops.quote: Today only a few signs of this intense industrial activity remain, as in Le Theusseret shortly before Goumois, the finish of the second stage.
stops.english: Today only a few signs of this intense industrial activity remain, as in Le Theusseret shortly before Goumois, the finish of the second stage.

stops.name: Soubey
stops.quote: 15 kilometres of meditative hiking pleasure and one of Switzerland's most beautiful "water trails" run between Soubey and St-Ursanne.
stops.english: 15 kilometres of meditative hiking pleasure and one of Switzerland's most beautiful "water trails" run between Soubey and St-Ursanne.

stops.name: St-Ursanne
stops.quote: The hike along the south bank from St-Ursanne to La Charbonnière is almost always along nature trails, close to the shimmering, blue-green waters.
stops.english: The hike along the south bank from St-Ursanne to La Charbonnière is almost always along nature trails, close to the shimmering, blue-green waters.
